cases.description: Verify that clicking the "Add note" button creates a new note appended to the document body as a div element with the class "note" containing a visible, empty <textarea> with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note button create separate notes

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering during typing
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown content into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in real-time with proper HTML formatting in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") and changes are immediately reflected in local storage.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown syntax without errors
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown (such as unmatched **) does not cause crashes or errors, and displays raw input when the user exits edit mode by clicking the 'Edit' button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Create new note and verify initial edit mode

cases.title: Toggle between edit and view modes
cases.description: Verify that clicking the Edit button (data-testid='edit-note-button') switches the note between edit and view modes, toggling the visibility of the main content area and the textarea accordingly.

cases.title: Automatic saving of typed changes to local storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Delete' button (data-testid='delete-note-button') associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load and display saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates a div element with the class note containing tools, main, and textarea elements, and renders the content in the main div with the textarea hidden by default.

cases.title: Display textarea and hide main div for stored notes with no content
cases.description: Verify that when retrieving stored notes from localStorage that have no content, the application displays the textarea and hides the main div for immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: clicking the 'Add note' button creates a new note appended to the document body as a div with class 'note', the note contains a visible and empty textarea with data-testid='note-textarea', and the application supports multiple rapid clicks creating separate notes each with its own textarea. Scenario types: Normal. Requirement R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: editing a note via textarea with Markdown rendering support, dynamic real-time rendering in main display area with proper HTML formatting as the user types, handling complex Markdown syntax without crashes or errors for invalid Markdown, displaying raw input when exiting edit mode by clicking the 'Edit' button, and immediate reflection of changes in local storage. Scenario types: Normal, Abnormal/Error (invalid Markdown). Requirement R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: creating a new note on page load or by clicking the 'Add note' button, note immediately entering edit mode with visible textarea and hidden main content area upon creation, switching between edit and view modes via 'Edit' button toggling visibility of main content area and textarea, and automatic saving of typed changes to local storage. Scenario types: Normal. Requirement R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: deleting a note by clicking the 'Delete' button with data-testid='delete-note-button', immediate removal of the targeted note from the DOM, and removal of the corresponding entry from localStorage. Scenario types: Normal. Requirement R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving and displaying saved notes from localStorage on page load, dynamically creating a div with class 'note' containing a tools div with 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons and a main div (data-testid='note-main') and a textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'), rendering retrieved notes with content displayed in main div and textarea hidden by default, showing textarea and hiding main div for notes with no content, showing no notes if localStorage is empty, and using an internal notes variable populated via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')). Scenario types: Normal, Edge (localStorage empty, notes with no content).

analysis.analysis: The requirements analysis identifies the testable behaviors, boundaries, normal paths, abnormal paths, and explicit scenario types for each requirement. For R-1: Normal path for clicking 'Add note', appending a note div with class 'note' and data-testid='note-textarea', and handling multiple rapid clicks. For R-2: Normal path for Markdown editing, real-time rendering, and local storage persistence; Abnormal/Error path for handling invalid Markdown without crashing and displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode. For R-3: Normal path for page load/button creation, entering edit mode by default (visible textarea, hidden main), toggling modes via the 'Edit' button, and auto-saving to local storage. For R-4: Normal path for deleting a note via 'Delete' button, removing it from the DOM, and updating localStorage. For R-5: Normal path for retrieving/displaying notes from localStorage on page load, rendering the note structure (tools, edit/delete buttons, main div, textarea), default view mode for notes with content, edit mode for notes with no content, and handling empty localStorage. Edge/Abnormal scenarios for R-5 are fully addressed by empty localStorage and empty-content notes.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 defines normal behaviors for adding a note: clicking the add button creates a div.note with a visible, empty textarea (data-testid='note-textarea'), and supporting rapid multiple clicks to create multiple separate notes. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 defines normal and abnormal/error behaviors for editing with Markdown: real-time rendering in data-testid='note-main', handling invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) without crashing, displaying raw input upon exiting edit mode via the edit button (data-testid='edit-note-button'), and immediate local storage updates. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 defines normal behaviors for mode switching: newly created notes enter edit mode with visible textarea and hidden main content area, toggling modes via the edit button, and saving changes to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 defines normal deletion behaviors: clicking data-testid='delete-note-button' removes the note from the DOM and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 defines normal, edge, and abnormal behaviors for loading from localStorage: parsing 'notes', rendering notes with main div visible and textarea hidden by default, showing textarea and hiding main div for empty-content notes, showing no notes when localStorage is empty, and managing note deletion persistence.

qualitative.rationale: Candidate round-1-candidate-3 adds a helpful distinct case (G-012) covering the persistence aspects of note deletion during page reload, aligning well with requirement R-5 details while maintaining clean test structure without regressions or duplicates compared to the accepted set.
